# delete

Delete a particular authentication profile

## Usage

```
ppds auth delete [options]
```

## Options

| Long | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--index` | `-i` | `int?` |  | The index of the profile to be deleted |
| `--name` | `-n` | `string` |  | The name of the profile to be deleted |
